title: Spew

description.main: Spew is the first book from spewedition, the label Daisuke Yokota founded in Tokyo in 2016 with Naohiro Utagawa and Koji Kitagawa. A 500-page wordless softcover of full-bleed black-and-white images by the three photographers, issued in a signed trade edition of 400 within a total run of 500.
description.extended:
Spew is the first book from spewedition, the label Daisuke Yokota founded in Tokyo in 2016 with the photographers Naohiro Utagawa and Koji Kitagawa, and the opening volume of a numbered series that followed.

It is a 500-page softcover, about 25 by 18 cm, with no text. Black-and-white images by the three photographers run full bleed from first page to last. Most are abstract: scanned and rephotographed prints, solarised figures, smeared and striated surfaces, with faces and rooms surfacing between them. The cover carries a blurred sepia portrait of a man in glasses, the word Spew set small at the lower right. The trade edition was 400 copies, signed by all three members. The rest of the 500-copy run went into limited variants, among them an Offprint Paris edition of 50 with hand-painted covers. The library copy is the deluxe edition, issued with a disc and a scented cover. Spew II followed the same year in the same phone-book format, and Spew III in a larger size in 2017. The label also issued zines, audio CDs and booklet sets.

Yokota (b. 1983, Saitama) made his name with the reworked black-and-white prints of Back Yard, Site/Cloud and Corpus. He received the Foam Paul Huf Award in 2016, the year this book appeared. Spew moved his process into a group. The three members publish without individual credits, perform live and build installations, and the label is the outlet for that shared material rather than for any one photographer.
description.artist_bio: Daisuke Yokota, born 1983 in Saitama, reworks his own black-and-white prints by rephotographing, heating and chemically abusing them (Back Yard, Site/Cloud, Corpus, Taratine). Foam Paul Huf Award 2016. In 2016 he formed the unit Spew with Naohiro Utagawa and Koji Kitagawa and the label spewedition, which publishes numbered Spew volumes, Remix Zines, Room booklet-and-CD sets, Record audio CDs and Mother editions, and stages live performances and installations.

notes: Shelf: Japanese. First book of the spewedition label, later referred to as Spew I; by the unit Spew (Daisuke Yokota, Naohiro Utagawa, Koji Kitagawa). No text. The library copy is the deluxe edition, with a disc and a scented cover, as described by the owner on 18 October 2026. No dealer listing found describes this variant: Chladek, photo-eye, Shelf and Book of Days list only the signed trade edition of 400 within a run of 500, and Humble Books the Offprint Paris edition of 50 with hand-painted covers and elastic-cord binding. The size of the deluxe issue, whether the disc is an audio CD, and whether the copy is signed are not recorded. Spew II (2016, 300 copies) and Spew III (2017, 300 copies, larger format) followed. No clean cover image was found online (Placart's is watermarked, photo-eye's is a detail crop), so the row has no cover.
